subagent_id.description: The subagent id returned when the background subagent was started (the subagentId from the subagent tool's continuable result).

timeout_ms.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait before returning status 'timeout'. Omit to wait indefinitely — usually the best choice. If set, use a generous value (minutes, not seconds); polling a subagent with repeated short waits is an anti-pattern — you are notified the moment it settles.
